description_expanded: ABOUT SURFER DOG: Welcome to "Surfer Dog," your ultimate beach getaway in Inlet Beach, Florida. Just steps from the white sugary sands, this 3,300-square-foot vacation home offers accommodations for up to 13 guests. Enjoy multiple master suites, furnished balconies with stunning Gulf views, and a spacious private gated pool, perfect for family vacations and group getaways on the World's Most Beautiful Beaches. The ground floor features an open-concept kitchen, living, and dining area, fully furnished for comfort and relaxation. With a pullout sofa, Smart TV, and a kitchen bar seating 4, this space is ideal for entertaining. The kitchen is equipped for all your culinary needs, whether you're preparing home-cooked meals or enjoying local delivery. The family-style dining table seats up to 8, making it perfect for group meals. The main level also includes a luxurious king master suite with private access to an outdoor furnished deck. Enjoy a quiet morning coffee on the South-facing bistro, listening to the waves. The master ensuite features double vanities, a spacious walk-in shower, and a soaking tub. Across the hall, the colorful multi-bunk room offers 2 twin over twin bunks and a pullout trundle, sharing a full-sized hallway bathroom. Upstairs, discover two additional suites. The queen suite boasts Gulf views, a private balcony entrance, and a luxurious ensuite. On the opposite side, the spacious king suite offers comfort and privacy with its full ensuite. Surfer Dog's outdoor amenities are just as impressive, with a private gated pool surrounded by loungers and coastal breezes. Enjoy the convenience of an outdoor shower, a full laundry room, and a wraparound porch. Book your stay at Surfer Dog today and experience the best of Inlet Beach, Florida-where luxury meets the Gulf Coast. ABOUT THE AREA: Inlet Beach is a charming beach neighborhood located along Florida's scenic Highway 30A. Known for its stunning white sandy beaches, crystal-clear waters, and relaxed atmosphere, Inlet Beach offers a peaceful coastal getaway for visitors seeking a more laid-back vacation experience. This quaint community is characterized by its quiet residential streets lined with beautiful beach cottages and upscale vacation homes, perfect for those looking to unwind and enjoy the natural beauty of the Gulf Coast. When you stay in Inlet Beach you are never far from the beach, or a magnificent view. To explore 30A, take a bike ride to Rosemary Beach to enjoy the farmers market, discover the new 30A Avenue shops, taste the fine local cuisine, and visit local businesses along 30A. Visitors can also explore the neighboring beach communities of Rosemary Beach, Seacrest Beach, and Alys Beach, each offering unique shopping, dining, and entertainment options. For additional shopping and adventure, take a family drive to Pier Park in Panama City Beach or travel to the Sandestin Outlet shops. Inlet Beach provides easy access to a variety of outdoor activities, including swimming, sunbathing, paddleboarding, kayaking, and fishing. The nearby Camp Helen State Park offers nature trails for hiking and birdwatching, while Lake Powell - one of Florida's largest coastal dune lakes - provides opportunities for boating and wildlife viewing. With its pristine beaches, serene ambiance, and proximity to a wealth of recreational opportunities, Inlet Beach is a hidden gem along Highway 30A, perfect for those seeking a peaceful retreat on Florida's Gulf Coast. BEACH ACCESS: * Wall Street Public Beach Access PROPERTY HIGHLIGHTS: * Steps to the beach * Private Pool * 2 sets of complimentary beach chairs & 2 umbrellas serviced. This is seasonal from March 1-October31. * 4 complimentary bikes PARKING: * Free Parking for up to 4 Vehicles PROPERTY RULES: * Must sign rental agreement within 48 hrs of booking or subject to cancellation * Must be 25 years or older * No Pets Allowed * Smoking is not permitted * $500 Security Deposit required ABOUT PARADISE PROPERTIES: When you book your vacation in Florida's Panhandle with Paradise Properties Vacation Rentals and Sales, you can expect first class customer service from the moment you inquire. All of our properties are professionally cleaned, inspected, and maintained at the highest level. We are located close to all of our properties and we are available 24 hours per day and 7 days per week to ensure your vacation is flawless. Our goal is to build a lasting memory for all of our guests. **Please be aware this area has a lot of development and new construction going on at all times. At any given point, adjacent properties to properties we manage may go under construction without notification. Paradise Properties is not liable for any construction happening outside of the properties we manage.
